title: 2002 AMC 8 Problem 4
statement: The year \(2002\) is a palindrome (a number that reads the same from left to right as it does from right to left). What is the product of the digits of the next year after \(2002\) that is a palindrome?

solutions.text:
We don’t want to increase the thousands digit, so we can keep that as \(2.\)

This means that we have to increase the tens and hundreds digits to \(1,\) to yield the next palindrome of \(2112.\) The product of its digits is \(4.\)

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: The next palindrome after \(2002\) still starts and ends with \(2.\)
The middle two digits must increase to the smallest matching pair.
